title: Machine learning predicts PTSD at 1, 3 and 6 months in hospitalized trauma patients
summary: Five models (logistic regression, random forest, SVM, XGBoost, neural network) used psychosocial and routine biochemical variables from 382 trauma patients and were externally validated in 204. Best AUCs were 0.84 (SVM, 1 month), 0.78 and 0.87 (random forest, 3 and 6 months). SHAP ranked ASDS scores as the top predictor at all time points.
ai_technology: Five machine-learning models with SHAP interpretation

evidence.tested: External validation in an independent trauma cohort.
evidence.unknown: Cohorts are small and from one country. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: ML models predicted PTSD from routine clinical data and psychosocial scores.
